name: Ace Studio
tagline: Founder-led product design studio for AI companies, with six published case studies
description:
Ace Studio is a founder-led product design studio for AI companies. Rico leads each project. The homepage says the studio works with a few teams at a time, in engagements of 4 to 8 weeks. The work covers product direction, design systems, and interfaces for products that use agents.

The site publishes six case studies: Alpaca, Aster, Scout, Langdock, Twin, and Marketer. Each page names the product and the scope. The homepage claims 3 members, 56 companies, and 150 shipped projects. It shows no prices. A call is booked with Rico, or by email to rico@acedesign.io.
pricing_detail: No published rates. The homepage says engagements run 4 to 8 weeks. Book a call at https://cal.com/team/ace-studio/discovery-call, or email rico@acedesign.io. On 2026-10-12 the homepage still said it was taking one new project for September.
agent_guidance:
Use it as a benchmark for a small product studio that designs AI products and design systems. Read the six case studies for scope and visual direction, then compare that with the homepage service list.

The site is a Framer build. Read the case studies in a browser, because the pages are image-led. Do not treat the homepage totals as checked facts. The site states them, and it publishes no team page and no prices.
why_it_matters: It shows how a studio presents product work for AI companies, with six named case studies and no public prices.
tier_reason: Six named case studies show the craft, but the site publishes no prices and no team page.
evidence: Checked https://acedesign.io/, /works, /notes, /work/alpaca, /work/aster, /work/scout, /work/langdock, /work/twin, /work/marketer, /robots.txt, and /sitemap.xml in curl and Chromium on 2026-10-12. The homepage lists six case studies and claims 3 members, 56 companies, $20B+ in company valuation, and 150+ shipped projects. The notes page is a letter to founders and says Rico leads every project. /about and /pricing return 404. The /laboratorium page is placeholder text and was not used. The preview is a screenshot of the works section. The owner shared https://acedesign.io/ on 2026-10-12.
